jam_besuk.catatan: Visitors must wear a visitor badge, limit the number of companions and keep the room quiet. Children under 12 are not allowed into inpatient rooms.

jadwal.keterangan: Biological parents only, accompanied by a nurse

aturan: Carry your ID and wear the visitor badge at all times inside the hospital
Do not bring food or drinks into isolation rooms and the ICU
Please step out while nurses perform medical procedures
Smoking is prohibited throughout the hospital area

langkah: Come to the Registration Counter on Level 1 (or book online via the Make Appointment button on this website)
Fill in the registration form / present your ID card and insurance card
Receive your polyclinic queue number from the officer
Confirm your next control visit schedule at the relevant polyclinic
Make sure your membership status is active (check via the Mobile JKN app)
Come to the Registration Counter with your KTP, KIS card and referral letter from your first level facility
The officer verifies your membership status online
Receive the polyclinic queue number according to your referral
BPJS zoned inpatient care is provided on Level 3 subject to KRIS class availability

hak: To receive humane medical care without discrimination
To know the care plan and costs transparently
Your diagnosis and treatment data are kept confidential by the hospital
To give or withhold consent for a medical procedure (informed consent)
To obtain a second opinion from another specialist
To submit complaints and feedback through the suggestion box & call center
kewajiban: To entrust your care to the doctors and health professionals
To provide honest and complete medical information
To follow treatment instructions and care regulations
To respect the rights of other patients and staff
To settle administrative and treatment costs
To maintain facilities and keep the hospital orderly
